# HeadingController

```js
import { HeadingController } from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/utils/controllers';
```

Lit controller that parses a heading in the host's light DOM, for the host element to render in its shadow DOM.
The heading is the host's first direct child that is an h1-h6, or that has the heading attribute (e.g. a div or span that shouldn't be a heading).
It's rendered with the same tag, and its text can be wrapped in a link or button.
The heading attribute can take a heading level, h1-h6, which adds the matching .h1-.h6 class, so a non-heading looks like that level.
Include HeadingController.styles in the host's styles for the h1-h6 and .h1-.h6 styles.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `LitElement` | 'this' from a Lit element |
| `headingAttribute` | `String` | Attribute that marks a non-heading element as the heading. Default: 'data-heading' |
| `heading` | `Heading\|null` | The parsed heading, or null if the host has none. |

## Events

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cork-heading-update` | Fired when the parsed heading changes including the first parse on host connection, if the host has a heading. Bubbles and is composed. detail.heading: the heading, or null if it was removed. |
| `cork-heading-click` | Fired from the host when the heading's rendered button or link is clicked (see Heading's click). Bubbles and is composed.<br><br>• detail.heading: the heading.<br>• detail.originalEvent: the click event, e.g. to call preventDefault() on a link for an SPA router. |

## Methods

### constructor(host, opts)

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `LitElement` | 'this' from a Lit element |
| `opts` | `Object` | Options. |
| `opts.headingAttribute` | `String` | Attribute that marks a non-heading element as the heading. Default: 'data-heading' |

### static get styles

Styles for rendered headings: the h1-h6 elements, and the .h1-.h6 classes added by the heading attribute's value.

**Returns:** `Array` - Lit css results.

### render(opts)

Renders the heading for the host's shadow DOM, or nothing if the host has none.
The heading's text is wrapped in a link or button if it has one, with clicks wired up to heading.click.

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opts` | `Object\|String` | Options. A string is treated as opts.classes. |
| `opts.classes` | `String\|Object` | Classes for the heading element: a space-separated string, or a classMap object. Added to heading.headingClass, if it has one. |
| `opts.typeClasses` | `Object` | Classes for the heading element by content type, added to opts.classes. Keys: a, button, text. Each value is a string or classMap object, e.g. { a: 'nav-sub__title-linked', text: 'nav-sub__title' } |
| `opts.linkClasses` | `String\|Object` | Classes for the link or button inside the heading. |
| `opts.tag` | `String` | Tag to render instead of the light DOM heading's: h1-h6, div, span, or p. Others are ignored. |

**Returns:** `TemplateResult\|String`

### parse()

Parses the host's heading: its first direct child that is an h1-h6 or has the heading attribute.

**Returns:** `Heading\|null`

## Examples

**Instantiation**

```js
import { HeadingController } from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/utils/controllers';

// in the host element's constructor
this.ctl = { heading: new HeadingController(this) };
// or with a different heading attribute
this.ctl = { heading: new HeadingController(this, { headingAttribute: 'data-cork-heading' }) };
```

**Rendering**

```html
<!-- in your element template. Renders nothing if the host has no heading -->
${this.ctl.heading.render({ classes: 'panel__title' })}

<!-- or assign classes by content type, and override the tag -->
${this.ctl.heading.render({ tag: 'h3', typeClasses: { a: 'title-linked', button: 'title-linked', text: 'title' } })}
```

**Light DOM markup - heading**

```html
<my-element>
  <h2>Services</h2>
</my-element>

<my-element>
  <h2><a href="/services">Services</a></h2>
</my-element>

<my-element>
  <h3><button>Services</button></h3>
</my-element>
```

**Light DOM markup - not a heading**

```html
<my-element>
  <div data-heading>Services</div>
</my-element>

<!-- styled like an h2, with the .h2 class -->
<my-element>
  <div data-heading="h2">Services</div>
</my-element>
```

**Styles**

```js
// in the host element's styles
return [...HeadingController.styles, elementStyles];
```

## Typedefs

### Heading

Typedef: `Object`

Used by the HeadingController to represent a heading parsed from the host's light DOM.

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tag` | `String` | Tag name of the light DOM heading, e.g. 'h2', or 'div' for &lt;div data-heading>. |
| `headingClass` | `String\|null` | The heading attribute's value if it's h1-h6, e.g. 'h2' for &lt;div data-heading="h2">, or null. Added to the rendered element's classes, to style it like that heading level. |
| `title` | `String` | The heading's text: from its link/button, or its own text. |
| `href` | `String\|null` | The link's href as written in the markup, or null. |
| `target` | `String\|null` | The link's target attribute, or null. |
| `disabled` | `Boolean` | Whether the link/button has the disabled attribute. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String\|null` | The aria-label attribute of the link/button, or null. |
| `ele` | `HTMLElement\|null` | The light DOM link/button that supplied the title, or null. |
| `headingEle` | `HTMLElement` | The light DOM heading element. |
| `click` | `Function` | Click listener for the heading's shadow DOM button or link. Wired up by heading.render. Takes the click event.<br><br>• Fires cork-heading-click from the host, with the heading and the click event.<br>• For a button, then passes the click through to the light DOM button, so its listeners run.<br>• Links aren't passed through: they rely on their shadow DOM href, so listeners on a light DOM link don't run. Use cork-heading-click instead. |
| `render` | `Function` | Renders the heading for the host's shadow DOM, e.g. \${heading.render({classes: 'title'})}. Takes the same opts as the controller's render, or just a class string. |
| `renderedEles` | `Object` | The heading's elements in the host's shadow DOM, set when they render. Empty until then. |
| `renderedEles.heading` (optional) | `HTMLElement` | The rendered heading (or div/span) element. |
| `renderedEles.item` (optional) | `HTMLElement` | The rendered link or button, if any. |
